# GammaRips

> The nightly Combo A options dataset, 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, and 3-day excursion outcome history for AI agents—in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Codex.

GammaRips is an options-flow and contract-microstructure data engine for AI agents. Every trading night at 23:00 ET it scans ~3,500 optionable US stocks, filters to the top 100 liquid universe (3M+ session shares, 25+ listed strikes), and selects one out-of-the-money call per bullish name passing the Combo A specification (`Mid >= $1.00`, `OI >= 500`, `Delta 0.22–0.48`, `DTE 10–45`). At 05:30 ET each candidate is enriched with point-in-time Realized-vs-Implied Volatility (`rv_iv_ratio`), technical indicators, flow context, and grounded news catalysts. During market hours (09:02–16:52 ET), 10-minute intraday snapshots track resting open interest and active session volume.

Ask your agent for a trade plan and it queries the dataset: shortlisting candidates that pass morning liquidity and earnings checks, inspecting historical 3-day MFE/MAE outcome surfaces, and proposing entry, target, stop, and position size inside your risk budget. There is no shared daily pick endpoint.

## Catalyst Lab Research Findings (Why Combo A)

Validated across walk-forward audits of `N = 5,575` enriched contracts over 66 scan dates (`dev.parquet`) joined to BigQuery `enriched_option_outcomes`:

- **Volatility Ratio (`rv_iv_ratio >= 0.85`):** Realized-to-Implied Volatility ratio (`(ATR_14 / Price * sqrt(252)) / IV`) is the #1 quantitative predictor of favorable 3-day option excursions.
- **Resting Book Depth (`OI >= 500`, log-saturated to `5,000`):** Lifts 5-minute fast execution fills at the open from **30.3% to 50.1%** (`56.5%` at `OI >= 1,000`).
- **Tick-Size Friction Floor (`Mid >= $1.00`):** Escapes the $0.05 minimum tick-size penalty on sub-dollar options.
- **Gamma/Theta Sweet Spot (`Delta 0.22–0.48`, `DTE 10–45`):** Lifts 3-day Option Maximum Favorable Excursion (`MFE >= +40%`) from **27.6% to 35.4%**.

Historical walk-forward research on paper-tracked cohorts. Educational only. Not investment advice.

## The Pipeline

1. **23:00 ET Scanner:** ~3,500 optionable US stocks → 3M+ session share volume and 25+ listed strikes → top 100 by combined chain dollar volume and share volume → bullish calls passing `Mid >= $1.00`, `OI >= 500`, `Delta 0.22–0.48`, `DTE 10–45` (roughly 40 to 50 contracts).
2. **05:30 ET Enrichment:** computes `rv_iv_ratio`, technical indicators, flow context, and Gemini grounded news catalysts.
3. **06:30–07:00 ET Clean Feature View & Report:** materializes leakage-checked `enriched_features_v1` and publishes the daily intelligence report.
4. **09:02–16:52 ET Intraday Liquidity:** captures 10-minute contract snapshots (`get_liquidity`) so agents verify morning OI and active session volume.
5. **Earnings check:** the published pool is NOT earnings-screened. Agents call `get_signal(view="earnings")` on each candidate before planning a trade.

## MCP Server (Free 3-Contract Preview vs. Pro Full Dataset)

- **10-Second Free CLI Install (Claude Code):** `claude mcp add --transport http gammarips https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp`
- **Free Preview Endpoint:** `https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP; no card, no key). Serves the 3-contract pool preview (`get_pool(view="preview")`), daily reports, VIX/VIX3M regime context, NYSE market calendar, and methodology playbooks.
- **Pro Dataset Endpoint:** `https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro` (OAuth 2.1 sign-in) or `Authorization: Bearer gr_live_...` API key on `/mcp` or `/pro` ($29/mo founding price, 30-day free trial at https://gammarips.com/pricing). Unlocks all 9 tools: the full 40–50 contract daily Combo A dataset (`get_pool(view="enriched" | "raw" | "features")`), per-ticker detail and earnings checks (`get_signal`), 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots (`get_liquidity`), 3-day excursion outcome surfaces (`query_outcomes`), and minute/daily option price replay (`replay_contract`).
- **Open-Source Agentic Trading Harness:** https://github.com/DevDizzle/gammarips-harness (3-step morning workflow, exit rules, and evaluation ledger).
- **All 9 tools:** `get_pool`, `get_signal`, `get_liquidity`, `query_outcomes`, `replay_contract`, `get_regime_context`, `get_market_calendar_status`, `get_playbook`, `get_daily_report`.

## Pricing

- **Free ($0 forever):** 3-contract daily pool preview on https://gammarips.com/signals and `https://mcp.gammarips.com/mcp`, daily macro reports, methodology, and free reference MCP tools.
- **Pro MCP Access ($29/mo founding price, 30-day free trial):** full daily Combo A pool (40–50 contracts), 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, 3-day MFE/MAE outcome surfaces, and contract replay across all 9 MCP tools. $29/mo for the first 100 subscribers ($39/mo after). Cancel anytime.
